title: Baseline agent and harness evidence
summary: The starting point: the original agent before any self-improvement experiments.

title: Block reproduction file writes
summary: Stop the agent from writing reproduction scripts instead of fixing the actual bug.

title: Tool call action parser
summary: Parse the agent's tool calls more carefully so broken instructions don't crash the system.

title: Robust action extraction
summary: Extract what the agent wants to do even when its output is messy or incomplete.

title: Observation discipline for no-patch loops
summary: Train the agent to observe results before acting again, breaking the loop of doing nothing useful.

title: Source edit finalization
summary: Make sure the agent actually saves its code edits before declaring the task done.

title: LangGraph-style empty response recovery
summary: Recover gracefully when the agent sends an empty message, using LangGraph's built-in retry logic.

title: Bounded empty-response recovery repair
summary: Limit how many times the agent retries after getting empty responses, to stop it from looping forever.

title: Structured action contract for tool args
summary: Force the agent to follow a strict format when calling tools, so it stops sending garbled instructions.

title: No-patch control with bounded retries
summary: Add a retry limit for when the agent finishes without producing any code changes, to prevent wasted compute.

title: Hard finalization diff gate
summary: Refuse to let the agent finish unless it can prove it actually edited source files.

title: Ready-to-finish graph state
summary: Add a separate 'ready to finish' step the agent must pass, checking that code was actually changed.

title: Checkpointed finalization resume
summary: Save the agent's progress after code edits so it can pick up from there instead of starting over.

title: Third-iteration source-edit checkpoint
summary: After three rounds of work, force the agent to show what files it changed before it can wrap up.

title: Forced source-edit checkpoint
summary: Pause the agent right after it writes scratch files and redirect it to edit the actual source code instead.

title: Block untracked file writes and inject tracked-path sed guidance
summary: Stop the agent from writing to random files and guide it to edit only the right source code.
